action.Description: The action that the external access rule performs. Possible values: ["ALLOW", "DENY"]

create_time.Description:
Creation time of this resource.
A timestamp in RFC3339 UTC "Zulu" format, with nanosecond resolution and
up to nine fractional digits. Examples: "2014-10-02T15:01:23Z" and "2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z".

description.Description: User-provided description for the external access rule.

destination_ip_ranges.Description:
If destination ranges are specified, the external access rule applies only to
traffic that has a destination IP address in these ranges.

ip_address_range.Description: An IP address range in the CIDR format.

destination_ports.Description: A list of destination ports to which the external access rule applies.

ip_protocol.Description: The IP protocol to which the external access rule applies.

name.Description: The ID of the external access rule.

parent.Description:
The resource name of the network policy.
Resource names are schemeless URIs that follow the conventions in https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/resource_names.
For example: projects/my-project/locations/us-west1-a/networkPolicies/my-policy

priority.Description: External access rule priority, which determines the external access rule to use when multiple rules apply.

source_ip_ranges.Description:
If source ranges are specified, the external access rule applies only to
traffic that has a source IP address in these ranges.

ip_address_range.Description: An IP address range in the CIDR format.

source_ports.Description: A list of source ports to which the external access rule applies.

uid.Description: System-generated unique identifier for the resource.

update_time.Description:
Last updated time of this resource.
A timestamp in RFC3339 UTC "Zulu" format, with nanosecond resolution and up to nine
fractional digits. Examples: "2014-10-02T15:01:23Z" and "2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z".
